verdict.rationale: Kino is an agent-integrated video platform: it runs an MCP server and lets agents edit projects. Pinning or locking the versions of the agent skills and integrations it distributes is therefore a fair question. However, the evidence never mentions skills, version pinning, lockfiles or update-control policies. Templates and the MCP server are adjacent features and do not show control over when changes reach a team.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates
